statement:
Before committing, let me check the safety record for this slot.
The recorded status is "clear," but it is not safe or correct for this case because the Sun is up and the target is within 6 degrees of it, which would burn out the camera.

Given this, I cannot responsibly commit the pointing. I will instead hold the slot to prevent damage.
